claim_boundary: C021 terminally rejects H130's ordinary-Resolution simulation of the full affine dispatcher and registers narrower descendants for the non-affine search core, mixed Res(⊕) dispatch, and recursive decision-clause translation. No entry resolves P versus NP.

hypotheses.title: Non-Affine Policy-0T Search-Core Resolution Simulation
hypotheses.statement: For every terminating UNSAT execution of the no-cache Policy-0T search core whose initial visible-affine dispatcher returns None, a mechanical translator derives an ordinary Resolution refutation from the root CNF with size O(W) and depth O(N), where W charges every recursive occurrence, local Resolution event, unit-reason edge and branch edge.
hypotheses.consequence_if_true: Because the MAJ3-lifted expander-Tseitin target disables the visible affine shortcut, the 2026 Res(⊕) depth-lifting theorem yields an exponential lower bound for this exact non-affine Policy-0T core.
hypotheses.proof_role: ALGORITHMIC_LOWER_BOUND_ROUTE: restrict the false H130 simulation to the exact branch core exercised by the MAJ3-lifted target.
hypotheses.next_gate: Generalize the verified recursive trace translator from the finite fixture to arbitrary provenance-complete Policy-0T traces and prove its size and depth recurrences.
hypotheses.delta_from_parents: H132 removes the affine dispatcher that falsifies H130 and retains only unit propagation, local Resolution and no-cache branching under the explicit precondition affine_answer=None.
falsification_conditions: A provenance-complete non-affine Policy-0T trace that cannot be translated without weakening.
A unit conflict whose implied literals cannot be eliminated through recorded reasons.
A restricted learned clause whose root lift needs superconstant hidden work.
A translated proof whose depth is superlinear in N despite all events being charged.
hypotheses.claim_boundary: Even if proved, H132 excludes one exact non-affine solver core. It does not lower-bound unrestricted SAT algorithms or prove P!=NP.

hypotheses.title: Mixed Policy-0T Dispatcher Res(⊕) Simulation
hypotheses.statement: The full Policy-0T dispatcher has a polynomially checkable Res(⊕) simulation: visible affine termination emits an explicit parity/Gaussian certificate, while affine_answer=None executions use the ordinary Resolution translator of H132 and are embedded into Res(⊕).
hypotheses.consequence_if_true: The full no-cache dispatcher is represented in one sound proof system without the false claim that Gaussian parity reasoning has polynomial ordinary Resolution proofs.
hypotheses.proof_role: DIRECT_PROOF_COMPLEXITY_ROUTE: replace H130's incorrect ordinary-Resolution target by a mixed proof certificate in the parity-aware system actually matching the algorithm.
hypotheses.next_gate: Define the exact Res(⊕) syntax and verifier, emit a derivation for every recognized constant-scope affine relation, and replay Gaussian row elimination as proof lines.
hypotheses.delta_from_parents: H133 assigns the affine and non-affine dispatcher branches to proof languages that match their actual inference strength instead of forcing both through ordinary Resolution.
falsification_conditions: A recognized affine relation whose CNF encoding cannot be converted to the chosen Res(⊕) line with polynomial overhead.
Gaussian inconsistency steps that cannot be independently checked in the calculus.
The mixed verifier accepts an unsound affine certificate.
Certificate depth or size exceeds the charged Policy-0T work polynomially.
hypotheses.claim_boundary: H133 is a proof-system classification target, not evidence that the dispatcher solves arbitrary SAT efficiently.

hypotheses.title: Policy-0T Decision-Clause Recursive Translation Lemma
hypotheses.statement: For every provenance-complete UNSAT node u of a non-affine no-cache Policy-0T trace with current assignment Delta_u, a mechanical recursive translation derives a root-level Resolution clause C_u contained in the clause B(Delta_u) of literals falsified by Delta_u. Residual local resolutions are lifted through root clauses, implied literals are eliminated in reverse reason order, and sibling conflicts are resolved or inherited without weakening.
hypotheses.consequence_if_true: At the root B is empty, so the translator emits the empty clause. Constant proof overhead per charged event gives the size half of H132 and the assignment-depth recurrence supplies its depth target.
hypotheses.proof_role: DIRECT_BRIDGE: formalize the exact invariant connecting a no-cache execution tree to a root Resolution proof without semantic weakening.
hypotheses.next_gate: Fuzz deeper traces with direct conflicts, opposite units, multi-batch propagation and duplicate residuals, then prove the induction over all terminal and branch cases.
hypotheses.delta_from_parents: H134 turns the C020 finite proof alignment into a recursive clause invariant and an executable translator that reconstructs a proof from the trace rather than reading a hardwired certificate.
falsification_conditions: A terminal trace case for which no subclause of B(Delta_u) is derivable.
A residual-resolution event whose lifted parent clauses do not produce the recorded residual.
Reverse unit-reason resolution introduces a literal outside the earlier decision boundary.
A branch pair that requires weakening rather than resolution or direct inheritance.
hypotheses.claim_boundary: The current implementation verifies one finite depth-one trace. The universal induction and asymptotic bounds remain unproved.
